The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.3345 of 2021
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short "Cr.P.C.") is filed seeking quash of F.I.R in Crime No.75 of 2021 of Rapur Police Station, SPSR Nellore District.

entities.text: Rapur Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.
The aforesaid case was registered against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273 IPC and under Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that this is a covered matter in view of the earlier orders passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.5103 of 2019 and batch, whereby this Court has quashed several F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.
Therefore, He would submit that the petitioner, who is similarly placed, is also entitled for the said relief and thereby prayed for quash of the F.I.R.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would also fairly concede that this is a covered matter in view of the earlier orders of this Court and thereby prayed to pass appropriate orders in this Criminal Petition also.

Therefore, in view of the aforesaid earlier orders of this Court and for the reasons stated therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the above F.I.R registered against the petitioner is hereby quashed.

Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, in the Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
